answer: Witness re-execution panels catch clone farms at the nadir of cheap parallelism. First, every answer hashes into a thirty-second micro-check. Second, a VRF picks three established witnesses outside your invite grove. Third, each must re-run that check within twenty minutes or the reward voids. Fourth, two fails burn a 60 POA bond and bar the next grading seat. Standing up 500 fakes means bribing about 1,500 strangers before dawn at roughly 20 POA each—30,000 POA—plus another 30,000 locked in bonds, like paying random bakers to remake one loaf from your oven.
